boundary: Occurrence counts prove the event name ships in the CLI. They do not prove a matching tool invocation occurs in every model trajectory. Registered events are allowed when observed, every observed hook process must succeed, and only the ordered required-event subset is mandatory per attempt. This analytic suite requires no event class per attempt; its discarded canary separately forces and verifies both registered hooks. Re-collect this evidence against the exact CLI version before freezing a measurement manifest.

events_deliberately_not_registered.PostToolUseFailure: The event exists in the CLI (see event_occurrences), but the exact treatment candidate does not configure the failure-nudge hook. The study therefore makes no claim about that guardrail; if a future candidate registers it, the runner permits it as an optional registered class while still failing any observed nonzero hook process.

method: Resolve the claude executable, read `claude --version`, then count literal ASCII occurrences of each event name in the resolved bundle bytes.
purpose: Direct external evidence that every hook event this suite registers exists in the provider CLI, so the claim does not rest only on this project's own frozen list.
